verdict.rationale: Digits documents Ask Digits, a built-in AI financial assistant. Its product page says it can "Complete tasks" and has a task mode ("Ask Digits to Get it Done"), so users can delegate work to an assistant inside the product, not only ask questions. Missing for 10: detail on which tasks Ask Digits can actually carry out and with what limits or approvals, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
